name: South Dakota

jury_list.holder: Clerk of courts / Unified Judicial System.

voter_file.who_may_get: Anyone. The Secretary of State posts the complete statewide voter registration file on its website every Monday, with a free five-year archive (SDCL 12-4-37, 12-4-37.1).
voter_file.permitted_uses: May not be sold or used for any commercial purpose (campaign and political polling are not commercial) (SDCL 12-4-41).
voter_file.penalty: Class 1 misdemeanor and a civil penalty up to $2,000 per violation (SDCL 12-4-41).

sources.cite: SDCL 12-4-37 and 12-4-37.1 (weekly posting; archive; month and day of birth not public)

private_challenge.who: The Secretary of State, the county auditor, or any individual registered to vote in the same county as the challenged voter (SDCL 12-4-59).
private_challenge.form_or_statute: SDCL 12-4-59 (ground (3): 'Is a United States citizen', added by SL 2026, ch 67), 12-4-60 (affidavit on the State Board of Elections form), 12-4-61 (auditor review, verification request, 30 days, hearing).
private_challenge.deadlines: Not later than the 90th day before a primary, runoff, special, or general election (12-4-59). The auditor may not cancel a registration challenged under 12-4-59 within the 90 days before an election (12-4-61).
private_challenge.evidence_standard: Affidavit that, 'to the best of the individual's personal knowledge and belief, having exercised due diligence to personally verify the evidence presented,' the voter is not qualified; documented evidence attached; no 'unsupported allegation or the allegation of an anonymous third party' (12-4-60).

sources.cite: SDCL 12-4-60 (affidavit, personal verification, documentary evidence; Class 2 misdemeanor for publishing confidential IDs)
SDCL 12-4-61 (auditor process; no cancellation within 90 days)

state_windows.effect: No challenge may be filed after the 90th day before an election, and no cancellation within 90 days.

county_board.name: South Dakota county auditors (Secretary of State directory)
county_board.note: Registration challenges under SDCL 12-4-59 go to the county auditor.

state_election_office.name: South Dakota Secretary of State - Elections and Voting

gates.basis: The jury record status is unknown (null), so the app shows counts only. A private citizenship challenge exists (SDCL 12-4-59) but needs personal verification and documents, and it closes on day 90. Guidance stays off while the jury list is not available.

notes: The voter file is posted publicly by the state, but re-posting it for unrestricted internet access is a Class 1 misdemeanor (12-4-41). JuryRoll never posts data.
false_statement_penalty is null: 12-4-60 penalizes publishing confidential identifiers (Class 2 misdemeanor), not false statements; general perjury law may apply.
official_pipeline is null: SDCL 12-4-18 covers incompetency, felony, and death, not jury citizenship. No jury pipeline was found.
For the November 3, 2026 election the 12-4-59 deadline (August 5, 2026) has passed.
